st: UK: The One with Cheap Sports Saloons
d: Jeremy, Richard and James find a trio of cars which are equally at home on the racetrack as they are at transporting a family to the store.
The cars put to the test include the Aston Martin Rapide, the Porsche Panamera Turbo and the Maserati Quattroporte in a search for the world's greatest four seat supercar.
The boys build cool and interesting motor homes before setting off for a holiday weekend in the West country.

st: UK: The One with Tom Cruise and Cameron Diaz
d: Richard takes the Volkswagen Touareg 4x4 to Sweden  Tom Cruise and Cameron Diaz are the "Stars in a Reasonably Priced Car."
Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May buy old British roadsters from Jensen-Healey, Lotus and TVR.
The trio travels to America  comparing the Mercedes SLS, the Porsche 911 GT3 RS and the Ferrari 458 Italia.
